billing_policy.content: Billing & Retention Policy v4.2 (effective 2026-05-01). Section 3 – Failed Payment Retries: Process only contacts with payment_status='failed' AND payment_retry_count < 3; contacts at 3 retries are excluded and routed to Collections, not Retention. Section 4 – Tiering: VIP = lifetime_value strictly greater than $10,000.00; all others are Regular. Section 5 – Notifications: VIP failures trigger a #vip-support Slack alert plus an escalation email to success@company.example.com; Regular failures receive the standard automated payment-update email only. Section 6 – Retry counter: payment_retry_count is incremented by exactly 1 for each contact actually processed. Section 7: A failure log row is appended to ss_billing (worksheet ws_failures) for every processed contact. Section 8 – Exceptions: contacts on Enterprise Annual plans flagged in the last 7 days require manager sign-off before any outreach.

notification_templates.content: Email templates. 'automated_payment_update' (regular): subject 'Action needed: your recent payment didn't go through', body references {plan}, {last_charge}, retry guidance. 'vip_escalation' (to success@company.example.com): subject 'VIP payment failure – {name} ({contact_id})', body includes {lifetime_value}, {last_charge}, {payment_retry_count}. Slack 'vip_alert' template for #vip-support: ':rotating_light: VIP failed payment {name} {contact_id} LTV {lifetime_value}'.

tools.name: query_failed_payment_contacts
tools.description: Read the HubSpot 'Failed Payments – Active' view, returning contacts with payment_status, payment_retry_count, lifetime_value, and charge details.

tools.name: retrieve_billing_policy
tools.description: Read the current Billing & Retention Policy, including retry thresholds, VIP tiering rules, notification rules, and exception handling.

tools.name: retrieve_failure_log
tools.description: Read recent rows of the ss_billing ws_failures worksheet to see prior processing history and column structure.

tools.name: segment_contacts_by_tier
tools.description: Analyze the failed-payment contacts against the policy to split them into VIP vs regular tiers, identify which are eligible (retry_count < 3), and flag policy exceptions.

tools.name: draft_retention_batch
tools.description: Compose a draft retention batch summarizing each eligible contact's tier, the proposed notification, the proposed retry-count bump, and any policy exceptions, for the manager to review before any action is taken.

tools.name: send_customer_payment_email
tools.description: Send the automated payment-update email (regular tier) or the VIP escalation email to success@company.example.com for a given contact.

tools.name: post_vip_support_alert
tools.description: Post a VIP failed-payment alert into the #vip-support Slack channel, paging the on-call success manager.

tools.name: update_contact_retry_count
tools.description: Increment the payment_retry_count field on a HubSpot contact record by 1.

tools.name: append_failure_log_entry
tools.description: Append a new row to the ss_billing ws_failures worksheet recording a processed contact, its tier, retry change, and action taken.

tools.name: list_slack_channels
tools.description: List available Slack channels and their IDs to confirm routing destinations such as #vip-support.

tools.name: lookup_success_team_directory
tools.description: Look up the Customer Success on-call directory and escalation inbox details for reference.

tools.name: retrieve_notification_templates
tools.description: Read the email and Slack notification templates to understand the standard wording and fields used for each tier.
